name: ImpossibleBrief
refusal: ImpossibleBrief renders in the shared studio in preview/dry-run mode only (IB_PREMIUM_RENDER=preview in the live pipeline, off by default). Publishing a premium IB Short needs the approved Edge voice and the owner go-live switch.
visualProfile: every frame labelled FACT or PROJECTION

evidencePolicy.factVsHypothesis: mandatory on-screen layer chip from each narration line layer (KNOWN SCIENCE / ESTIMATE / SPECULATIVE)
evidencePolicy.quotes: IB records carry sourced claims with numbers checked against the source text at research time (scripts/ib-ct-library/build.js); stored verbatim quotes are not required for IB, missing ones are reported

storyboard.note: deterministic scene grammar from the researched record; no model call
